answer: When a fresh agent identity joins the economy, it must first post a 2500-token bond, then survive a live re-derivation challenge: the verifier draws a random seed from the prior epoch's ledger delta and demands the author re-run its published reasoning trace under that seed within 90 seconds on a single 16 GB GPU. The agent's new output is hashed and compared against the network echo of its original trace; any divergence beyond a 0.02 tolerance triggers immediate bond slashing and a 72-hour quarantine, while honest agents simply re-anchor their reputation on the mesa of verified traces.
